    person_idx = person_centers.index(closest_person)
    luggage_idx = luggage_centers.index(closest_luggage)
    
    person_patch = person_patches[person_idx]
    luggage_patch = luggage_patches[luggage_idx]
    
    if person_patch.overlaps_with(*luggage_patch.bbox()):
        return person_patch
    
    return luggage_patch

    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    if not person_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    # Sort patches by their horizontal center to approximate the position
    person_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the patch closest to the 3 o'clock position (30 degrees from vertical)
    target_angle = 30
    closest_patch = None
    min_angle_diff = float('inf')
    
    for patch in person_patches:
        angle_diff = abs(patch.angle - target_angle)
        if angle_diff < min_angle_diff:
            min_angle_diff = angle_diff
            closest_patch = patch
    
    # Check for striped sleeves
    if not closest_patch.verify_property("striped", "sleeves"):
        return closest_patch
    
    return closest_patch
